limitations: Inclination is the Hips-to-Neck vector relative to world +Y. Knee flexion is 180° minus the hip/knee/ankle angle. These are actual retargeted geometry measurements, not authored intention.

Foot height refers to the foot joint. Separate equipmentContact records sample actual skinned equipment and rigid board/pole vertices; FullBody is evaluated for fall_roll/get_up. Sampling cannot exclude penetration between sample times.
Board-relative foot drift is reported when a named snowboard mesh node exists. It measures attachment stability; an incorrectly positioned but stationary boot can still pass.
Root angular travel is the sum of sampled quaternion geodesic angles. It detects missing rotation winding but does not establish correct trick direction or landing quality.
